item.description:
Asobi 1.0 (build 2152) Nov 5, 2026

  • Report a problem from Asobi. Help ▸ Report a Problem… sends a report or a suggestion to the studio's bug tracker, with pictures (grab Asobi's window or a panel, paste or drop one, and mark it up), a voice note, or a short recording of what you did. Help ▸ My Reports shows each one's status and the reply. A report that can't be sent waits and goes later.
  • Drop clips into someone else's review. Dropped on the playlist (or Review ▸ Add Clips to the Review…), they go straight into the review for everyone.
  • New clips reach everyone fast. Studio Macs open the original within seconds. Macs elsewhere and the web link wait for the clip's review copy, saying how far along it is, and go to it when it's ready.
  • Resync. Catch Up with the Room is now Review ▸ Resync. The host has Review ▸ Resync Viewers, and the web link has its own Resync button.
  • Compare with Plate in someone else's review now shows for everyone.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 2140) Nov 5, 2026

  • Catch Up with the Room. In someone else's review, Review ▸ Catch Up with the Room (or a right-click on the Live chip) takes you to the host's clip and frame at once, with any clips added since you joined.
  • Reviews stay in step. Every few seconds the host tells the room where it is. A Mac that has ended up on another clip, or stopped on another frame, goes back by itself.
  • The host's file, not just its name. A clip found by name must also match the host's file. If your Mac holds another file under the same name, Asobi switches to the host's when it can see it, and tells you when it can't.
  • Add Clips to the Review… A studio Mac in someone else's review can put clips into it. An internal review takes them straight in; otherwise the host is asked first.

1.0 (build 2136) Nov 4, 2026

  • Kitsu playlists play the version they name. A shot with the same version number on two tasks, such as a generative v006 and a comp v006, could play the one downloaded first. Each task's versions now keep their own file, and their name says the task.

1.0 (build 2132) Nov 3, 2026

  • The manual's chapter on matching the agency's grade has figures: how a match is fitted, the results window, placing a shot by hand, and grade versions.
  • Remote control reports the installed Kento and Kura Hub versions after they update, not the versions installed when Asobi started.

1.0 (build 2128) Nov 3, 2026

  • Match each shot's grade to the agency's cut. Color ▸ Match to Edit Ref fits a shot, or every shot of a conform, to the Edit Ref's grade, and lists the results worst first. Match to… matches a shot to any still or shot.
  • Grade versions. A matched clip keeps Original, Match 1, Match 2 and so on. The chip in the title bar names the one on; { } step them, ⌥{ ⌥} step the whole cut. The match's strength is in the Grade tab.
  • New versions keep the match. The version you pick is the shot's choice, and every new version of the shot opens with it. A new version whose color has drifted is flagged, with Match Again.
  • Place a reframed shot by hand. Place on Edit Ref shows the shot as a ghost over the agency's frame, in a box you drag into place.
  • Quitting no longer crashes while EXR frames are still being read.

1.0 (build 2107) Nov 2, 2026

  • Kitsu gets each marked frame once. Drawings brought in with Frame.io comments aren't sent to Kitsu, just as the comments aren't. A marked frame that an earlier link already sent isn't sent again unless it has a new note.

1.0 (build 2104) Nov 2, 2026

  • Kitsu gets each note once. While you host, notes go to Kitsu only if Kitsu doesn't already have them. Notes sent from an earlier link of the same session, or pasted into Kitsu by hand, aren't sent again.

1.0 (build 2102) Nov 2, 2026

  • Notes on a conform's shots go to Kitsu. A shot matched to Kitsu now sends its notes to the shot's Compositing task, live while you host a review and with Review ▸ Kitsu ▸ Publish. Each comment names the movie, its timecode and the frame within the shot. Comments brought in from Frame.io stay out.
  • Comment subtitles for everyone. While hosting, Review ▸ Comment Subtitles for Everyone (or the Show menu's Comment subtitles) turns them on for every Mac, page and phone in the room, at your position unless someone chose their own. Turning it off, or leaving, puts them back.
  • Fixed: joining a review of cut movies could show "Proxy stream failed… Cannot Open". A guest now waits for the host's copy of the movie, tries again, and says why if it can't get it.
